data.description: Like pollen on the wind or the roots of plants in the ground, your thoughts permeate your surroundings, allowing you to study and manipulate the world around you. Phrenic Pool Ability: Charisma. Discipline Powers: Your powers allow you to connect with and manipulate natural life.
